definitions.explanation: The south-facing exit of a train station, building, or other public facility.

examples.japanese: {南口|みなみぐち}で{待|ま}って。
{駅|えき}の{南口|みなみぐち}にバス{停|てい}がある。
examples.english: There's a bus stop at the south exit of the station.

examples.japanese: {南口|みなみぐち}を{出|で}たら、{右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がってください。
examples.english: After you go out the south exit, please turn right.

notes:
Used primarily for train stations, where exits are named by compass direction to help passengers navigate. Most major stations in Japan have named exits ({南口|みなみぐち}, {北口|きたぐち}, {東口|ひがしぐち}, {西口|にしぐち}), and these are essential for giving and understanding directions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駅|えき}の{南口|みなみぐち}: south exit of the station
- {南口|みなみぐち}を{出|で}る: to go out the south exit
- {南口|みなみぐち}{改札|かいさつ}: south exit ticket gate
- {南口|みなみぐち}ロータリー: south exit rotary/roundabout

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {北口|きたぐち}: north exit
- {東口|ひがしぐち}: east exit
- {西口|にしぐち}: west exit
- {出口|でぐち}: exit (general)
